name: czl-english-teacher-desk
description: A closed-loop teaching desk for senior-high English teachers: locate the class's real starting point, design units and lessons, build original papers from a two-way blueprint, mark writing with an error ledger, run review lessons with transfer drills, and close the cycle with evidence-based next-step decisions. Every deliverable ships with a self-check sheet and a printable docx.

displayDescription.en: A six-stage desk for senior-high English teachers: diagnose the class, design units and lessons, author original papers, mark writing, run review lessons, and close the loop with evidence.
